products.title: Sodium Ion Starting Battery 12V, 200Ah
products.body_html:
The Cranking Sodium Battery is designed for high-demand engines, marine applications, and other vehicles that need a powerful and dependable power source. Here is the details:

  • Lightweight & Powerful: At 25 lbs, it’s 60% lighter than standard SLA batteries.
  • High Cold Cranking Amps: 1300 CCA for reliable starting in cold weather.
  • Long-Lasting Energy: 200Ah capacity and 2,400 Wh for extended use.
  • Durable Design: Compact size with M8 screw-in terminals for secure connections.

Cranking / Starting Sodium Ion Battery

●     High Cold Cranking Power:
Designed for high-demand engines, marine applications, and vehicles requiring dependable power with 1300 CCA, it ensures reliable ignition in frigid conditions.

  • Lightweight & Easy to Handle:
    Weighing only 25 lbs, it’s 60% lighter than standard SLA batteries, making it easy to install, especially in applications where weight is critical, like boats.
  • Extended Usage:

Provides 200 Ah capacity and 2,400 Wh energy for sustained performance without sacrificing power.

  • Consistent Voltage:
    Provides a stable 12 V output with a 14.6 V charging voltage, enhancing the performance and lifespan of vehicle systems.
  • High Amp Support:
    Supports continuous charge/discharge up to 100A, ideal for demanding applications, while a recommended 50 A or less ensures longer battery life.
  • Compact and Versatile:
    Its compact size and F12 screw-in terminals make it adaptable to various setups, suitable for modern boats, vehicles, and backup power needs into 2024 and beyond.
